name: Hops
short: No related adverse events in a 12-week trial of a matured hop extract; a valerian-hops combination was well tolerated. A 19-man study of hop extract reported nausea, bloating and abdominal discomfort.
text: The human safety data found were for hop extracts and a valerian-hops combination. In a 12-week randomised, placebo-controlled trial in 200 overweight adults, no adverse events related to a beverage containing matured hop extract, and no clinically relevant abnormal changes in circulatory, blood or urine measures, were observed, and a valerian and hops combination was reported as well tolerated in a randomised, placebo-controlled study in 40 participants with a 21-day treatment period. In a randomised crossover trial in 19 healthy-weight men, a hop extract given in capsules releasing in the stomach or the duodenum produced small but significant increases in gastrointestinal discomfort (such as nausea, bloating and abdominal discomfort), with mild to severe gastrointestinal symptoms reported with the stomach-release capsules only. No interaction data were found in the cited sources.
